name: Direct-operate command interface
aliases: substations Substation automation and command interfaces
summary: Identifies the assigned command path that does not use a separate selection transaction.
description: Identifies the assigned command path that does not use a separate selection transaction. Station automation collects measurements and statuses and issues assigned commands through defined authority paths. A communicated point has a value, quality and equipment identity; it should not be treated as an unexplained contact.

In a substation control building, the station controller receives bay information and forwards an operator's selected command to the correct bay device. Device feedback confirms whether the intended result actually occurred. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Authorized direct command” at the input and “Assigned device operation request” at the output. Command acceptance differs from operation confirmation.
